name: astock-paper-frontend
description: Astock paper-trading dashboard. Legacy vanilla JS/CSS sources are bundled into dist/ with esbuild; dist/ is committed so Docker and the local uvicorn server can serve it without a Node runtime.

scripts.check:dist: git diff --quiet -- frontend/dist || (echo 'frontend/dist is stale: run npm run build and commit the result' && exit 1)
